attributes.action: Remove Ben Wadey as EastEnders’s executive producer
attributes.additional_details: Please join me in my petition to remove Ben Wadey as producer of EastEnders
attributes.background: The UK government should intervene into the BBC Soap Opera EastEnders, which the government loves to fund the bbc. The executive producer Ben Wadey is incompetent and should resign immediately. He has no idea how to produce a show and his only notable achievement is a Hollyoaks time jump. Congrats
